title: Samira — Toutes ses copines sont mariées
style: Modern stylized 3D animation, warm color palette, soft cinematic lighting, expressive character, high quality render

character.name: Samira
character.description: Samira, a 32-year-old North African woman, long dark brown hair, warm brown eyes, elegant modest style, emerald green dress at the wedding and casual chic beige coat elsewhere, gentle tired smile

scenes.vo: Samira adore les mariages. Elle en a fait douze cette année. Aucun n'était le sien.
scenes.image_prompt: Samira in an elegant emerald dress applauding at a festive wedding reception, golden lights, guests dancing around a bride and groom in the background
scenes.motion_prompt: She claps and smiles at the celebration, golden light bokeh flickering, slow push-in on her face as her smile softens

scenes.vo: Et à chaque fois, la même question. « Et toi Samira, c'est pour quand ? »
scenes.image_prompt: Two older aunties in festive attire leaning toward Samira at a decorated wedding table, knowing smiles, Samira with a polite forced smile holding a glass of juice
scenes.motion_prompt: The aunties lean in speaking with animated gestures, Samira nods politely, her smile tightens slightly

scenes.vo: Elle sourit. Elle répond « bientôt, incha'Allah ». Mais dans le taxi du retour…
scenes.image_prompt: Night interior of a taxi, Samira in the back seat looking out the window, city lights of Paris sliding across the glass, her reflection pensive
scenes.motion_prompt: City lights stream across the window, slow zoom on her reflection in the glass, she exhales quietly

scenes.vo: Le problème de Samira, ce n'est pas elle. C'est son cercle. Travail. Maison. Famille. Où est-elle censée le rencontrer ?
scenes.image_prompt: Split-mood illustration of Samira's daily routine: at her office desk, in her small kitchen, on her sofa with her phone, muted colors, same three locations repeating
scenes.motion_prompt: Subtle parallax between the daily routine panels, she scrolls her phone on the sofa, the light dims slightly

scenes.vo: Les applis classiques ? Elle a essayé. Des conversations qui meurent. Des intentions floues.
scenes.image_prompt: Close on Samira's phone screen showing a generic dating app chat with a dead conversation, her thumb hovering, her face lit blue in the dark living room, disappointed
scenes.motion_prompt: She scrolls through empty conversations, shakes her head slightly, blue light flickers on her face

scenes.vo: Puis une amie lui parle de Nour Meet. Des soirées en petit comité. Des participants vérifiés. Des gens qui cherchent la même chose qu'elle : du sérieux.
scenes.image_prompt: Samira's face lighting up warmly as she looks at her phone showing a clean app interface with an upcoming dinner event in a Parisian restaurant, warm golden glow
scenes.motion_prompt: Warm light grows on her face, her eyes brighten, she sits up with new energy

scenes.vo: Une soirée. Une vraie table. De vraies conversations.
scenes.image_prompt: A warm Parisian restaurant evening, Samira laughing naturally at a small elegant dinner table with a few verified participants, candles and mint tea, genuine atmosphere
scenes.motion_prompt: Natural laughter around the table, candlelight flickers, gentle lateral camera movement

scenes.vo: Et cette fois, quand la question est revenue au mariage suivant… Samira a juste souri. Différemment.
scenes.image_prompt: Back at another wedding, Samira in a beautiful dress smiling serenely and confidently, a soft knowing glow about her, warm celebration lights behind
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow zoom on her serene confident smile, golden bokeh shimmering behind her

scenes.vo: Les rencontres sérieuses existent encore. Nour Meet. Inscris-toi gratuitement.
